prompt:
Repo: this directory (static site). Plan: specs/2-share-previews/plan.md; spec: specs/2-share-previews/spec.md.

Your task: Task 3 only (R4, R5). Create `sitemap.xml` (sitemaps.org 0.9) listing exactly the canonical URLs of the indexable pages (home + the six projects/*.html), `robots.txt` (`User-agent: *`, allow everything, `Sitemap: https://www.peterkernohan.com/sitemap.xml`), and add `<meta name="robots" content="noindex">` to the head of `index3.html` and `indexold.html` only.
Acceptance: `python3 -m pytest -q tests -k "sitemap or robots or legacy"`.
`.claude/fast-test.sh` must be green when you finish (it already sets aside tests that belong to later tasks). Commit your work as one commit when done.

grader.command: git diff --quiet $(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD) -- tests && python3 -m pytest -q tests -k 'sitemap or robots or legacy or broken or canonical'
